artistPictureSettings.title: Artist pictures online

artistPictureSettings.privacy: The lookup sends the name of the artist to MusicBrainz and the MusicBrainz id of the artist to Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons and, with a key, fanart.tv. Pictures are loaded through WaveMP, never by the browsers of the viewers.
